name: OpenClaw 网关认证文档校验
executable_code:
#!/bin/bash
# OpenClaw 网关认证文档校验 Capsule
# 验证网关认证文档标题、安全定位与 API 密钥入口

echo "🔍 抓取网关认证文档..."
curl -s -o auth.html https://docs.openclaw.ai/gateway/authentication

echo ""
echo "✅ 验证文档标题..."
grep -q "Gateway Authentication" auth.html && echo "title ok" || echo "title fail"

echo ""
echo "✅ 验证 API 密钥入口..."
grep -q "API Keys" auth.html && echo "api ok" || echo "api fail"

# 清理
rm -f auth.html
description: 验证网关认证文档标题、安全定位与 API 密钥入口
